g.text: Torculus · DRAFT / project contours subject to review
Intervals are staff steps. Black = ink; green = nominal anchors / lyric. Blue = selection head.
Reference outlines: Greciliae 6.1.0 (Gregorio). Nominal-cell normalization, not full TeX placement.
Green dots are semantic anchors, not inferred head centers. Blue middle-head overlay is interaction-only.
Review artwork only. No app implementation. Exact proposed paths and bounds: specimen-recipes.json.
Approved controls at 1×: Punctum / Podatus Δ1, Δ3 / Clivis Δ1, Δ2, Δ3, Δ4
